scope: Research candidates, not publishable county landing pages
methodology: One primary-source indexed extract reviewed per county. Facts are paraphrases of retrieved extracts, not live operational verification. Candidate means a plausible owner-workflow connection, not sufficient evidence for publication. Limited means local evidence or owner connection remains too generic, old or unverified. All proposed website tasks are editorial inferences and require the actual business owner’s service details.

counties.name: Albany

sources.title: Guide to Albany County Craft Beverage Trail
sources.facts: The current tourism guide describes a purchasable Albany County Craft Beverage Trail pass.
sources.verification: Parent researcher directly opened redesigned tourism guide and narrowed obsolete indexed wording.

editorialInference.websiteTask: For a participating producer, explain the verified pass-redemption process separately from ordinary reservations.

counties.uncertainty: Site redesigned or redirected; earlier indexed mobile-passport and tasting-flight wording is not supported by the current page. Confirm participation and exact benefits with the producer.

counties.name: Allegany

editorialInference.websiteTask: For lodging serving trail users, distinguish existing access from planned connections on an arrival page.

counties.uncertainty: Planning activity is not proof a trail is open; requires route-level verification.
